description: This file defines extension methods for the Orleans.TestingHost TestCluster, providing utility functions to retrieve configuration, configuration values, and test cluster options from an IHostBuilder or IConfiguration.

classes.name: TestClusterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring and retrieving settings for Orleans test clusters.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the IConfiguration object from the IHostBuilder's properties.

methods.name: GetConfigurationValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific configuration value by key from the host builder.

methods.name: GetTestClusterOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the TestClusterOptions from the host builder's configuration.

methods.name: GetTestClusterOptions (overload)
methods.description: Binds configuration settings to a TestClusterOptions object.
